citybus.title:
A simpler way to
meet your city’s buses
citybus.description: From finding a bus to transferring and exploring a city, CityBus brings the transit information each city needs into one place.
citybus.featuresTitle: Information for every part of the journey
citybus.featuresDescription: CityBus features follow the way people move through a city, rather than sitting in a flat list. Availability varies by city.
citybus.arrivalTitle: Find the bus you can take now
citybus.arrivalDescription: See nearby stops, arrival estimates, service status, and the live location of buses in one place.
citybus.mapDescription: Search stops and routes, then follow stops along the way, direction, first and last buses, and service intervals on the map.
citybus.transferDescription: Every CityBus app lets you choose a start and destination to see transfer points and walking segments on the map.
citybus.railDescription: In supported cities, find station locations, live arrivals, direction-based timetables, first and last trains, and station information.
citybus.travelDescription: Every CityBus app includes attraction locations, details, and directions on the map, along with city-specific events and tourism content.
citybus.favoriteTitle: Keep the information you use most
citybus.favoriteDescription: Save stops and routes, then keep notes, arrival alerts, and weather information close at hand.
citybus.citiesDescription: Every app includes essential bus information plus transfers, an attraction map, and weather, with city-specific additions such as urban rail, seat information, and events.
citybus.finalTitle:
Start moving around
your city more easily
citybus.finalDescription: CityBus keeps building the transit information each city needs, one step at a time.

movlog.title:
Today’s movement becomes
your own story.
movlog.description: From routes and places to the weather and photos, Movlog automatically captures your day and brings it together at a glance.
movlog.introKicker: Let the day pass, not the story
movlog.aboutTitle:
Without trying to log it,
your day comes together.
movlog.aboutDescription: Movlog automatically organizes movement and visits. Meet your day again through mapped routes and a chronological timeline.
movlog.trackingDescription: Movlog captures routes, distance, time, and speed while distinguishing driving from walking. Visits and parking become part of the same day.
movlog.trackingPoint1: Background recording with no extra steps
movlog.trackingPoint3: Weather and visit events in context
movlog.archiveTitle:
Find it on the calendar,
remember it in the timeline.
movlog.archiveDescription: Find any day in monthly and yearly archives, then revisit movement, visits, and photos in order. Add a note to keep the memory with it.
movlog.contextTitle:
Keep more than a location.
Remember the moment.
movlog.contextDescription: Movlog records not only where you were, but the context that helps you remember the day.
movlog.visitTitle: Where you went and how long you stayed
movlog.visitDescription: Movlog detects visits and dwell time automatically, connecting them to the flow of your day.
movlog.weatherDescription: See the weather from your trip and around your current location alongside your log.
movlog.photoTitle: Turn photos into memories on the map
movlog.photoDescription: Connect photos to visited places and rediscover them inside your movement log.
movlog.parkingTitle: Remember where you left the car
movlog.parkingDescription: Movlog naturally connects driving, parking, and the visit that follows.
movlog.insightsTitle:
Find your patterns
in the story so far.
movlog.insightsDescription: Explore your farthest day, most visited places, and longest stays. Movement, visits, and photos become achievements and levels that make keeping a log more rewarding.
movlog.insightStat1Detail: The shape of your everyday radius
movlog.insightStat2Detail: New records in distance and time
movlog.insightStat3Detail: A sense of progress that grows with every log
movlog.galleryTitle:
From the start of the day to looking back,
one continuous flow.
movlog.privacyDescription: Movlog does not collect, process, or retain personal information. There is no advertising tracker—just an experience focused on recording your day.
movlog.finalKicker: TRACE YOUR PATH, TELL YOUR STORY
movlog.finalTitle:
Start with today’s movement.
Make it your story.
movlog.finalDescription: Movlog is available to download for free on the App Store.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Devp-YG distributes the following applications (collectively, the "Devp-YG Applications").
privacy.applies: This privacy policy applies to the Devp-YG Applications listed above.
privacy.appList:
• Daejeon Bus – Daejeon Metropolitan City
  • Busan Bus – Busan Metropolitan City
  • Gwangju Bus – Gwangju Metropolitan City
  • Andong Bus – Andong, Gyeongsangbuk-do
  • Yeosu Bus – Yeosu, Jeollanam-do
  • Incheon Bus – Incheon Metropolitan City
  • Tplus Mobile real-time usage widget
  • Movlog: Map Your Story

  • SnapQR
  • Chungnam National University Weekly Meal Plan
  • Chungnam National University Library

articles.title: Article 1 (Purpose of Personal Information Processing)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications comply with the Personal Information Protection Act and follow this policy to protect the personal information of all application users.

articles.title: Article 2 (Processing and Retention Period of Personal Information)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not collect, process, or retain personal information.

articles.title: Article 3 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not provide personal information to third parties.

articles.title: Article 4 (Entrustment of Personal Information Processing)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not outsource personal information processing.

articles.title: Article 5 (Items of Personal Information Processed)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not process any personal information.

articles.title: Article 6 (Destruction of Personal Information)
articles.body: Because no personal information is collected, there are no matters related to its destruction.

articles.title: Article 7 (Measures to Ensure the Security of Personal Information)
articles.body: Devp-YG ensures the security of personal information by not collecting, processing, or retaining it.

articles.title: Article 8 (Installation, Operation, and Refusal of Automatic Collection Devices)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not install or operate devices that automatically collect personal information.

articles.title: Article 9 (Personal Information Protection Officer)
articles.body: Devp-YG takes overall responsibility for work related to personal information processing.

articles.title: Article 10 (Changes to this Privacy Policy)
articles.body: This privacy policy takes effect from the date each application is released on the App Store.
